title: schema design exchange
description: A compact exchange format for requesting and returning JSON Schema design work. Send a prose request in value with type 'draft' to receive concise prose clarification questions and recommendations. Send a prose request in value with type 'final' to request the completed JSON Schema. A final response uses type 'final' and returns that JSON Schema as the value object.

type.description: A draft request or draft response. The value is prose: a request on input, or concise questions and recommendations on output.

value.description: Plain-text schema-design request, clarification questions, or recommendations.

type.description: A final request or final response. A request supplies prose as value; a response supplies the completed JSON Schema object as value.

anyOf.description: Plain-text final request describing the schema to produce.
The completed Draft-07 JSON Schema returned in response to a final request.

examples.value: We need a schema for lesson inquiries. So far we collect date, student, age, contacts, and interests. What else should we consider?
Clarify whether this record ends at intake or tracks follow-up. Consider an optional learner name, contacts referenced from contacts.json, availability, lesson goals, and a free-text notes field.

Create a standalone Draft-07 schema for a lesson inquiry. It records the received date, an optional learner name, contacts using contacts.json, free-text interests, availability, and notes. It covers intake only.

value.title: example
value.description: A minimal example of a completed schema returned as a final response.
